description: Paid data access. Returns no records itself: it builds the HTTPS query URL for your filters and returns the x402 payment terms (USDC on Base; amsterdam-events $0.005, security-advisories $0.003, eu-tenders $0.01, eu-funding $0.005, cert-advisories $0.003, eu-medicines $0.005 per call). Send a GET to http_endpoint with an x402 client (v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE or v1 X-PAYMENT header) to receive up to 100 matching records; no account or API key. Filters per dataset: amsterdam-events: from, to, district, q, min_visitors, limit, offset; security-advisories: cve, vendor, product, q, added_since, ransomware, min_epss, limit, offset; eu-tenders: country, cpv, q, deadline_after, deadline_before, published_since, min_value, nature, limit, offset; eu-funding: q, programme, status, type, deadline_after, deadline_before, min_budget, limit, offset; cert-advisories: cve, vendor, product, q, cert, country, type, updated_since, kev, limit, offset; eu-medicines: q, type, category, substance, atc, area, holder, status, flag, shortage, updated_since, limit, offset. For free records without filters use get_sample.

dataset.description: Dataset id. amsterdam-events: Amsterdam events; security-advisories: Security advisories; eu-tenders: EU public tenders; eu-funding: EU funding calls and grants; cert-advisories: European CERT security advisories; eu-medicines: EU medicines: authorisations, shortages, safety communications and referrals (EMA).

filters.description: Optional filters as name to string value, for example {"country":"NLD","cpv":"72","limit":"5"}. Allowed names per dataset are listed in this description and in list_datasets.

http_endpoint.description: GET this URL with an x402 payment to receive the records.

payment_required.description: Always true: the endpoint needs an x402 payment.

x402.description: x402 v1 payment requirements (scheme, network, asset, amount, payTo); v2 terms come in the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header of the endpoint.
